_doc: v10 edit decision list. All positions are frame numbers at 30 fps. Output frame k shows at k/30 s. A scene's source frame is src_in + (k - start); the source is the project timeline in edit/common.py (79.77-101.07 s is the existing slow-motion plate). Cuts land on the first frame at or nearest each musical event in music.json. The renderer reads this file, so the render can be audited against it.

scenes.name: Before the song
scenes.src_label: 3.60-4.70 s: calm, looking into the lens; left girl lifts a hand to her hair
scenes.motivation: Song pickup (0.03 s) to the first accent at 1.10 s. A real-footage opening, like the reference's colour intro.
scenes.subject: colour_grade
scenes.graphics: A gold ink line draws in from the left edge and becomes the brush that reveals S2

scenes.name: Ink and paper
scenes.src_label: 14.80-16.67 s: both laugh into the camera
scenes.motivation: Lands on the accent at 1.10 s and holds for one 4-beat phrase plus a beat (1.87 s), so the laugh plays out uncut.
scenes.subject: sepia_duotone
scenes.graphics: Botanical ink drawings and hatched hills draw themselves on; slow parallax drift

scenes.name: Indigo paint
scenes.src_label: 35.30-36.37 s: hands over the face, then a smiling reveal
scenes.motivation: Hard cut on the strong onset at 2.97 s. The first paint stroke lands on the accent at 3.35 s, as the hands open.
scenes.subject: bw_contrast
scenes.graphics: Two v4 textured brush strokes (bristles, granulation, splatter) sweep across on the accents

scenes.name: Graphic burst
scenes.src_label: 48.90-51.23 s: two hair flips, the most energetic movement in the footage
scenes.motivation: Cut on the strongest accent in the song (4.05 s, off-beat). One continuous shot whose world changes on every beat, the reference's piece-to-piece device, with six curated panels.
scenes.subject: bw_warm
scenes.graphics: Six designed panels (gold constellation, coral sun rays, Bauhaus arcs, line waves, halftone, concentric arcs); a small settle on each cut

scenes.name: Golden sky
scenes.src_label: 89.20-91.40 s (slow-motion plate): petals fall, an arm reaches up and swings
scenes.motivation: Bar downbeat at 6.36 s, the start of the final phrase. The climax is the slow-motion petal moment.
scenes.subject: golden_colour
scenes.graphics: Painted dusk sky with clouds on three parallax layers, light beams and illustrated falling petals

scenes.name: The embrace (v4)
scenes.src_label: 95.00-96.43 s (slow-motion plate): the hug, both smiling, cheek to cheek
scenes.motivation: Hard cut on the strong accent at 8.57 s. Resolves on the existing v4 climax frames (blue paint arcs, white pen outline), which are preserved.
scenes.subject: v4_render
scenes.graphics: v4 paint arcs as rendered; a warm grade; the picture fades out over the last 8 frames as the excerpt ends

transitions.reason: The gold line from S1 becomes a cream brush stroke that wipes the ink world in, completing just after the 1.10 s accent.
On the strong onset at 2.97 s. A change of colour temperature (warm to indigo) gives the impact.
Her hands open outward at the end of S3, and the hair flip continues that outward motion at the start of S4. On the strongest accent (4.05 s).
A warm gold light (not white, never full frame) swells into the bar downbeat at 6.36 s and clears to reveal the sky.
On the strong accent at 8.57 s: from the reach to the embrace.
The excerpt ends at 10.0 s; the picture resolves to black over the last two eighth-notes.
